# Seidar — llms.txt (docs.seidar.xyz)

Seidar is a DeFi position manager on Stellar (Soroban): create, leverage,
shift and automate Blend V2 / XOXNO / Peridot positions in one atomic tx.

## Domains
- seidar.xyz -> apps/web (landing)
- app.seidar.xyz -> apps/app (dashboard: portfolio, blend, xoxno, peridot,
  savings, shifter, recipes, automate, settings)
- docs.seidar.xyz -> apps/docs (this site)

## Contracts (contracts/)
- recipe_executor: execute_recipe(user, recipe). Rules: non-empty, FlashLoan
  first and at most once, user.require_auth, reentrancy guard, events.
- guardian: add_rule / execute / remove_rule / get_rule / list_known.
  Triggers: HealthBelow(bps) | PriceBelow(scaled). One-shot fire, cooldowns,
  persistent() subs with TTL bumps.
- adapters: Blend maxLtv 7500, XOXNO 8000, Peridot 7000 (bps).
- flash_receiver: exec_op(pool, from, asset, amount) with pool.require_auth.

## SDKs (packages/)
- @seidar/sdk: Recipe, boostRecipe, repayRecipe, quoteFee, feeTierBps
  (1 stable / 10 correlated / 25 uncorrelated, +5 automation).
- @seidar/positions-sdk: healthBps, healthStatus, borrowLimit, netApy,
  aggregatePortfolio.
- @seidar/automation-sdk: shouldFire, offCooldown, evaluateRule.
- @seidar/tokens: ASSETS, PROTOCOLS, toStroops/fromStroops.
- @seidar/ui: theme (black #000000 canonical).

## Services (services/)
- keeper: polls health/prices, calls guardian.execute when evaluateRule fires.
- credits: gas-credit ledger (sponsored bucket, then user-pays USDC).
- indexer: RPC events -> portfolio/history DB.

## MCP (mcp/)
Read + quote + build tools returning unsigned intents. No key custody.

## Key invariants for agents
- Never invent pool addresses; read contracts/configs/networks.json.
- Soroban tx = exactly 1 InvokeHostFunction; batch via recipe_executor.
- SDEX/Classic ops are NOT callable from contracts; automated legs use
  Soroban AMMs (Soroswap pools, Aqua, Phoenix) only.
- Health < trigger does not act alone; guardian re-checks on-chain.
